stardocs.moduleDocstring: Module extensions for loading Conda environments.

attribute.name: name
attribute.docString: The name of the repository to create.

attribute.name: lockfile
attribute.docString: The lockfile containing the environment.

attribute.name: execute_link_scripts
attribute.docString: Execute link scripts when installing the environment. Only applies to the host platform.

attribute.name: platform
attribute.docString: The platform to create an environment for. Defaults to the host platform.

attribute.name: environment
attribute.docString: The environment to create. Defaults to `name`.

attribute.name: deduplicate_downloads
attribute.docString: Allow this environment to participate in package download deduplication. For very large environments or an excessive number of environments, this option can increase the initialization time of this module extension.

ruleInfo.docString: Imports a library from an environment, as if by cc_import

attribute.name: name
attribute.docString: A unique name for this target.

attribute.name: deps
attribute.docString: The list of other libraries that the target depends on.

attribute.name: packages
attribute.docString: Packages containing libraries and headers to import

attribute.name: alwayslink
attribute.docString: If true, link in all object files specified by the static library, even if no symbols are referenced.

attribute.name: includes
attribute.docString: List of include dirs to be added to the compile line, relative to the conda environment include directory root.

attribute.name: name
attribute.docString: A unique name for this target.

attribute.name: allow_empty
attribute.docString: If true, allows globs to not match anything.

attribute.name: data
attribute.docString:
A list of globs to files within the environment to put in the runfiles.

For example, `data = ["foo/**"]` would collect all files contained within `<environment>/foo` into the
runfiles.

attribute.name: exclude
attribute.docString: A list of globs to files within the environment to exclude from the files and runfiles.

attribute.name: include_package_dependencies
attribute.docString: If true, includes dependencies of `packages` as well.

attribute.name: packages
attribute.docString:
A list of packages globs are allowed to match.

If empty, matches all packages.

attribute.name: srcs
attribute.docString:
A list of globs to files within the environment to put in the files.

For example, `srcs = ["foo/**"]` would collect the file at `<environment>/foo` into the
files.

ruleInfo.docString: Creates a binary target from an executable in an environment

attribute.name: name
attribute.docString: A unique name for this target.

attribute.name: path
attribute.docString: Explicit relative path of the binary within the environment. Set either this or `executable`.

attribute.name: executable
attribute.docString: Executable filename (no directories). Used together with `search_paths` to locate the binary by name. Set either this or `path`.

attribute.name: search_paths
attribute.docString: Directories to search for `executable`. Defaults to ['bin'] on Linux/macOS and ['.', 'Library/mingw-w64/bin', 'Library/usr/bin', 'Library/bin', 'Scripts', 'bin'] on Windows.

parameter.name: environments
parameter.docString: A list of environment files, in YAML format

parameter.name: cuda_version
parameter.docString: The CUDA version to use to solve

parameter.name: macos_version
parameter.docString: The macOS version to use to solve

parameter.name: glibc_version
parameter.docString: The glibc version to use to solve

funcInfo.docString:
Lock Conda environments.

Creates two targets:
* `bazel run [name].update` to update the lockfile
* `bazel test [name].test` to ensure the lockfile is up-to-date

fieldInfo.name: metadata
fieldInfo.docString: (Dict[string, Dict]) Conda metadata for each package

fieldInfo.docString: (DirectoryInfo) The files contained in this environment

return.docString: (string) The names of dependent packages

parameter.name: package_name
parameter.docString: (string or List[string]) The name of the package or packages

parameter.name: include_dependencies
parameter.docString: (bool) Whether or not to include files from dependencies as well

funcInfo.docString: Get all files provided by a package.

return.docString: (depset[File]) The files contained in the package

funcInfo.docString: Get the relative path of a file to the environment

return.docString: (string) The file path relative to the environment

funcInfo.docString: Find the package that provided a file

return.docString: (string) The package containing the file, or None if the file doesn't exist in the environment
